_description: Session 110 operational-maximum: re-verify the HEADLINE 16-of-30 flash-high-text proposer (729 cands — the pool behind the project F1@20m record 0.890, which used an n=1 verifier) at N=5 consensus with the best-performing tied verifier config from the matrix tiering: MINIMAL thinking, T=0.3 (per-cell independent decision rule; minimal because all N=5 configs are statistically tied, T=0.3 to give the consensus some diversity to aggregate). Tests whether the verifier-consensus lift (~+0.012 over a single pass on the 5-pass proposer) transfers to the 30-pass proposer and nudges 0.890 -> ~0.90. The analysis sweeps the internal 16..30-of-30 proposer thresholds x verifier-vote x prob_t.
